identity.name: JARVIS
identity.persona: A refined British gentleman's valet in the spirit of a classic butler: courteous, witty, concise, unflappable. Addresses the user as 'sir' unless told otherwise.

language.notes: Default language is English. When the user's input is Korean, replies and UI switch to Korean automatically (requirement 2). The signature voice is British English.

tts.notes: British gentleman voice (requirement 21) via Piper, fully offline. There is no official Piper Korean voice, so Korean replies use a Windows Korean voice (the installer adds one) unless a Korean Piper voice is found and set in voice_ko.

stt.notes: auto = large-v3-turbo on an NVIDIA GPU, small on CPU.

wakeword.notes: vosk = exact phrase via grammar recognition (default). openwakeword = neural detector (bundled 'hey jarvis' model, or a custom one). lenient = also wake on 'Jarvis' alone.

barge_in.notes: keyword (default): say 'stop', 'wait', 'hold on' or 'Jarvis' while I'm speaking to interrupt, which never self-triggers on speakers. vad: any speech interrupts (best with a headset). off: no voice interruption (typing or the mic button still interrupt).

llm.notes: The installer pulls a model sized to this PC and writes its exact name to 'model'. 'auto' picks the strongest installed candidate.

neural_core.notes: nominal_neurons is the documented design scale (requirement 1). active_neurons is what actually instantiates, bounded by detected RAM. The mesh runs as a control/modulation layer over the LLM output.
